summary: A new fixed bottom CTA bar component and safe-area/bottom-padding utilities were added, and the landing page now imports the component and applies bottom padding. However, the provided diff excerpt does not clearly show the bar being rendered on the landing page nor that its click handler is wired to `initiatePayment` from `useUpiPayment(...)`.

missing_requirements.requirement: Render a sticky/fixed persistent bottom “buying” CTA bar on `frontend/src/pages/TechifyLandingPage.tsx` that remains visible while scrolling.
missing_requirements.reason: `TechifyLandingPage.tsx` imports `PersistentBottomCtaBar`, but the truncated diff does not show it being included in the returned JSX.

missing_requirements.requirement: Bottom CTA must trigger the existing UPI flow by calling `initiatePayment` from `useUpiPayment(...)` (including deep-link + fallback dialog behavior).
missing_requirements.reason: `initiatePayment` is obtained from `useUpiPayment(upiPaymentLink)`, and the bottom bar exposes `onBuyClick`, but the diff snippet does not show `onBuyClick={initiatePayment}` (or equivalent) being passed when rendering the bar.

hallucinated_features.description: Persistent bottom CTA bar includes specific offer copy (“Canva Pro — ₹399/Year”, “Instant activation • Premium tools”, “Buy Now”) and an icon (Sparkles).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-31 requires a persistent buy CTA in English and wiring to existing payment flow, but does not specify the exact marketing text/iconography.
